settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Standard delivery takes 5–7 business days. Express delivery (2–3 business days) is available at checkout for most pin codes.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking link via email. You can also log in to your account and view your order status under My Purchases.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and prepaid wallets. Cash on delivery is available on select pin codes.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Visit our Start a Return page, fill in your order details, and our team will arrange a pickup within 2 business days.

settings.question: Can I exchange for a different size?
settings.answer: Yes. During the return process, select 'Exchange' and choose your preferred size. Exchanges are subject to availability.

settings.question: How do I use a discount code?
settings.answer: Enter your discount code in the 'Discount' field at checkout. Only one code can be applied per order.
